name: web-notification-list-over-gradient-promo-card-on-blue-teal-glow
title: White notification list with avatars, coloured reaction badges and 'Just now' over a red-orange-blue sphere promo card with a PROMOTED tag, on a blue-teal glow
whatItIs: A dark navy background with a blue and teal glow at the bottom left, a white notification card with rounded avatars each with a small coloured badge (like, message, plus), bold names and grey 'Just now', and behind it a gradient card of overlapping red, orange and blue spheres with a translucent 'PROMOTED' pill.
whatItMeans: Lively and clear; stacked white and gradient cards show engagement and promotion in one image.
techniques: Stack a white list over a gradient card.
Add small reaction badges on avatars.

vocabulary.definition: A small coloured icon on an avatar.
